name: Scenmed

attributes.attribute: fought Cúchulainn after he carried off Emer

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Scenmed was an Irish heroine. She was a warrior woman who led her army into battle against the great Ulster hero Cúchulainn. She took this course after Cúchulainn carried off her niece Emer. The hero used the battle skills he had learned from Scáthach, an amazonian woman of Scotland, to defeat Scenmed. Her defeat belongs to the cycle of Cúchulainn, that great champion of the Ulaid. The tale shows a woman who led men in arms, a role allowed in Irish legend. Scenmed met the hero in open battle rather than from ambush. Her loss set no mark on the wider record, yet the note survives that a warrior woman could stand against the foremost fighter of the land.
